headline: Levine Leichtman Capital Partners Acquires Stake in Concentric Energy Advisors
summary: Private equity firm Levine Leichtman Capital Partners has completed a growth investment in Concentric Energy Advisors, partnering with the company's existing management team.
why: Levine Leichtman is a middle-market private equity firm that typically provides capital for growth, recapitalizations, and management buyouts.

impacts.name: Concentric Energy Advisors
impacts.why: Private equity investment provides capital for growth and operational changes.
